name: Half-Life FX: Single
storyline:
An agent in a brand-new suit, the mysterious G-Man, makes you an offer that "you can't refuse", and you understand this perfectly well, so without much hesitation you agree...

The game begins where original Half-Life story ends. You will once again visit the underground complex of the secret Black Mesa laboratory, to put an end to the consequences of the failed experiment once and for all.

We won't reveal the complete story line, but to give you a hint, it will not be limited to Black Mesa alone - you will have to visit other equally colorful places.
summary:
A singleplayer mod for Half-Life, powered by the Half-Life FX Graphics Add-on, which demonstrates a lot of its new features.

There is an intro and one full game level, where you will fight the soldiers, solve a couple of problems in the Half-Life style and even open the keypads with previously found key codes. Some graphic features where not used and therefore cut away (parallax mapping, volumetric fog). However in the full version of HLFX: Single we plan to use them.
